jobs.title: AI-Native Marketing Lead (Growth)
jobs.description:
**AI\-Native Head of Marketing — RestauNax**

Location: Remote (United States preferred; must overlap US Eastern business hours)

Type: Full\-time

Reports to: Founder

Compensation: Salary \+ equity in the company \+ performance bonus tied to qualified demo volume

ABOUT RESTAUNAX

RestauNax is an all\-in\-one platform for independent restaurants and home\-based food businesses: point of sale, online ordering, restaurant websites and apps, in\-store menu TVs, self\-order kiosks, AI voice ordering, and built\-in marketing tools. We are a founder\-led, early\-stage company based in Tampa, Florida, and we sell to owners who are too busy running a kitchen to sit through a sales cycle. Our marketing has to earn its own attention.

We already run a 150\+ page SEO site with programmatic city and state guides, a blog, competitor comparison pages, free tools for restaurant owners, paid campaigns on Google, Meta, and Microsoft, and an affiliate/partner program. What we do not have yet is one person who owns all of it and runs it the way a modern team should: with AI doing the heavy lifting and a human making the calls.

THE ROLE

You will own marketing end to end: brand, social media, content, SEO, paid, email, PR, partners, and everything in between. Not "manage an agency," not "write briefs for freelancers." You run it. If a marketing team would normally do it, it is yours.

We are specifically looking for someone who has already rebuilt their own workflow around AI. If you still draft every piece of content by hand, build every ad variant manually, or pull reports into a spreadsheet on Friday afternoons, this is not the role for you. If you have spent the last couple of years figuring out what AI is actually good at in marketing, and what it is not, we want to talk.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

* Own the full funnel from first impression to booked demo: brand, social, SEO, content, paid, email, partners, and conversion.
* Run our social media presence. Own Instagram, TikTok, Facebo

jobs.description:
About Redo

Redo is the ecommerce post\-purchase platform for returns, managed returns, shipping/fulfillment, OMS, warranties, and AI support \- used by 4,500\+ brands. We're hiring for our Reverse Logistics Cloud.

We're not looking for someone who wants a normal engineering job. We want people who push to find out what they're capable of, who want to be surrounded by teammates who make them question if they can keep up, who set goals other people would laugh at and get fired up instead of scared off. If you want outsized rewards for outsized contribution, and you run at hard problems instead of away from them, you might be a Redo person.

About the role

Set technical direction for the Reverse Logistics Cloud. Staff means architecture for returns, managed returns, and logistics integrations \- plus unblocking seniors and making the GM's roadmap executable. We hire for root\-cause thinkers who make the right tradeoffs, not surface patches.

How we work

In\-office in Draper, 5 days/week. High\-output culture: long days, tight collaboration, occasional weekend push when shipping matters. We want people who lean into that.

What you'll do

\- Own architecture for return lifecycle, disposition, WMS/3PL sync, inventory correctness with OMS

\- Lead high\-stakes integrations where correctness and latency both matter

\- Break ambiguous problems into work other engineers can execute

\- Raise quality across the cloud: standards, reviews, reliability

\- Mentor seniors; multiply the team through design docs and clear decisions

\- Grow leadership capacity as we scale eng teams

What we're looking for

\- 7\-10\+ years building production systems; senior\+ scope for several years

\- Deep full\-stack \+ backend (TypeScript / Node.js / React / AWS or equivalent)

\- Complex multi\-system integrations (WMS, 3PL, ERP/OMS, ecommerce)

\- Architecture ownership across a product area

\- Strong written communication

\- Bonus: reverse logistics, high\-volume ecommerce ops, prior
